body: Forward test of the base rate method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.58 (naive base rate 0.50) that: IOL Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals FY27 consolidated operating margin is ≥14.0%. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (2-Nov-2026): Q2 revenue ₹795 cr (+~40% YoY), EBITDA ~₹115 cr, margin 14.4%; H1 revenue ₹1,551 cr (+39%), EBITDA ₹227 cr, margin 14.5%. Mgmt: FY27 '25% plus revenue growth with 14% to 15% of EBITDA'; 'Q3 and Q4… perhaps we should have the same performance'; ethyl acetate/acetic anhydride at full utilisation with better prices; other expenses up on power/fuel and freight (hopes to pass on). Screener OPM: Dec-25 10%, Mar-26 15%, Jun-26 14%, Sep-26 14%. Ibuprofen expansion FY28. Reasoning: Commodity-chemical margins mean-revert; the recent step-up from ~10% to ~14–15% came with favourable spreads (cycle-dependent). H1 at 14.5% means H2 only needs ~13.5%, so modestly above a coin-flip. Resolution: YES if FY27 consolidated Operating Profit ÷ Sales on screener.in's annual P&L ≥14.0% (if screener is unavailable, EBITDA excl. other income ÷ revenue from operations from the Q4 FY27 results). Source: screener.in IOLCP annual P&L; IOLCP Q4 FY27 results. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs base rate.

body: Forward test of the promise-tracker credibility method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.30 (naive base rate 0.25) that: Salesforce's initial FY28 revenue guidance midpoint implies ≥10% YoY growth over FY27 actual revenue. Evidence: Q2 FY27 release (26-Aug-2026): revenue $11.3bn (+11%, incl. $456m Informatica), subscription & support +12%; cRPO $33.5bn (+14%); FY27 revenue guide raised by $200m to $46.1–46.4bn (+11–12%); CFO Washington: 'NNAOV growth is the strongest it's been in four years, keeping us on track for second-half organic revenue reacceleration'; Agentforce + Data 360 ARR ~$3.9bn (+210%); Contentful and Fin acquisitions expected to close in Q3 FY27. Yahoo: CRM $180.62 on 20-Nov-2026 (52-wk $146–269). Reasoning: Promise-tracker: management has promised organic reacceleration. FY28 loses most of the Informatica inorganic boost (deal laps during FY27), so a ≥10% guide needs either real organic acceleration (cRPO +14% hints at it) or meaningful Contentful/Fin contribution. Salesforce's recent initial guides have been 7–9% (from memory, unverified). We go slightly above the base because cRPO is leading revenue. Resolution: YES if (midpoint of the initial FY28 revenue guidance range in Salesforce's Q4 FY27 release ÷ FY27 reported revenue) − 1 ≥ 10.0%. Use reported (not constant-currency) figures. Source: Salesforce Q4 FY27 earnings release (8-K, EDGAR). Resolve by 2027-03-15; score with Brier vs base rate.
